Hi All,

I see this subject has been touched-on in the past, like here: https://groups.google.com/forum/#!searchin/shiny-discuss/modal/shiny-discuss/iUkKPKhcqmM/_S8k7wYgT2kJ

My question is slightly different, to propose a modalButton that could be used, for example, for help windows.

Here's the idea - not too different from other ones I have seen floating around here:

https://gist.github.com/ijlyttle/9ace92f4f56246375859

Could something like this be considered as a function offered in the shiny package? I'm sure there is a better way to implement it, to make it more general, if need-be.

What do you think? Is this worth opening an issue? 

Thanks,

Ian
